notes.title: Zurarararush!!! Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]Notice[/h3][p]Due to major changes and adjustments, the [b]online ranking has been reset[/b].
[/p][h3]System Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Upgraded to [b]Unity 6[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added outlines to enemy characters and their projectiles for better visibility[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slow-motion effect[/b] is now triggered when the player uses a bomb[/p][/*][*][p]Items now [b]follow the player[/b] when the player is in their path, making them easier to pick up[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Invincibility & Speed-Up[/b] item has been replaced with an [b]Invincibility[/b] item; its visual effect has also been updated[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]Boomerang Zura[/b] to now fire in [b]3-way shots[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In multiplayer mode, each player now has a separate [b]Zura UI display[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]In Score Attack mode, only [b]easier-to-use Zura types[/b] will appear in the early stages[/p][/*][*][p]The first stage background in Score Attack mode has been updated to better fit the game’s setting[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy HP to ease overall difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]If a bomb is used during the effect duration of the Invincibility item, the [b]invincibility duration may end prematurely[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are actively working on fixing any bugs that arise during gameplay.
Due to prioritization of development tasks, some aspects of the [b]user experience (UX)[/b] may still feel rough or incomplete.
We appreciate your understanding and patience.[/p]

tags.feature: Added outlines to enemy characters and their projectiles for better visibility
Slow-motion effect is now triggered when the player uses a bomb
Items now follow the player when the player is in their path, making them easier to pick up
The Invincibility & Speed-Up item has been replaced with an Invincibility item; its visual effect has also been updated

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the Boomerang Zura to now fire in 3-way shots

tags.feature: In multiplayer mode, each player now has a separate Zura UI display

tags.balance_change: In Score Attack mode, only easier-to-use Zura types will appear in the early stages

tags.feature: The first stage background in Score Attack mode has been updated to better fit the game’s setting

tags.balance_change: Reduced enemy HP to ease overall difficulty

tags.bug: If a bomb is used during the effect duration of the Invincibility item, the invincibility duration may end prematurely

notes.title: [ver0.1]Zurarararush!!! Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]High Score Submission[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now choose in the options whether to automatically submit your high scores when achieved.
[*] Enabled manual high score submission from the Ranking Menu.
[/list]
[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted enemy spawn locations in certain areas.
[*] In multiplayer mode, the game will no longer start unless two controllers are connected.
[/list]

tags.feature: You can now choose in the options whether to automatically submit your high scores when achieved.
Enabled manual high score submission from the Ranking Menu.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted enemy spawn locations in certain areas.

tags.bug: In multiplayer mode, the game will no longer start unless two controllers are connected.
